component.name: PoktCode
component.summary: AI IDE with Providers catalog, Pokt Agent, and privacy-first defaults

description.p: PoktCode is a desktop IDE built on Eclipse Theia, focused on AI-assisted development without giving up a full coding environment. It ships with its own branding, theme, welcome experience, and the Pokt Agent integrated through Theia AI.

The Providers screen is the standout feature: browse a large catalog of AI backends, filter by free, connected, API key, OAuth, IDE subscriptions, or local/self-hosted, then connect what you need. Use local runtimes such as Ollama and LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Hugging Face, and many more—manage keys and OAuth logins in one place and pick models for chat, image, and video workflows.

Pokt Agent works beside the editor with modes for ask, plan, edit, agent, debug, review, and architecture. It can use project context, skills, MCP servers, an embedded browser preview for multimodal screenshots, and optional voice tooling. Telemetry is off by default; you stay in control of which remote providers are allowed.
